mapper.sql: b.id, b.student_id, b.academic_term, b.category, b.item_name, b.points, b.evidence, b.status, b.reject_reason, b.reviewer_id, b.reviewed_at, b.created_at, b.updated_at, b.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS class_name, sp.major AS major, sp.grade AS grade, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.real_name, ''), r.username) AS reviewer_name
FROM eval_bonus b LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = b.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users r ON r.id = b.reviewer_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_bonus (student_id, academic_term, category, item_name, points, evidence, status, reject_reason, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{academicTerm}, #{category}, #{itemName}, #{points}, #{evidence}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE b.student_id = #{studentId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.academic_term = #{academicTerm} ORDER BY b.academic_term DESC, b.id DESC

SELECT
WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND b.status = 'counselor_approved' ORDER BY b.student_id, b.category, b.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eval_bonus WHERE deleted = 0 AND academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND status = 'submitted'
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_bonus SET academic_term = #{bonus.academicTerm}, category = #{bonus.category}, item_name = #{bonus.itemName}, points = #{bonus.points}, evidence = #{bonus.evidence}, status = 'submitted', reject_reason = NULL, reviewer_id = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{bonus.id} AND student_id = #{bonus.studentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE eval_bonus SET status = #{toStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
